description: Compute the Italian codice fiscale (tax code) of a person from surname, name, sex, birth date and birth place, with the D.M. 23/12/1976 rules. The place can be a comune ('Roma', 'Castro (LE)'), a foreign state ('Francia') or a codice catastale ('H501'); the code valid on the birth date is used. Returns the 16 characters and why each group has its value. The Agenzia delle Entrate may assign an omocodic variant: only it confirms a code.

birth_place.description: Comune (with province if ambiguous), foreign state, or codice catastale / Z-code.
